value.value:
@concat('"SELECT DISTINCT	

	ELIG.MEME_CK,

	GRGR.GRGR_CK,

	ELIG.SGSG_CK,

	ELIG.PDPD_ID,

	ELIG.CSCS_ID,

	ELIG.CSPI_ID,

	OC.ID AS CASE_ID, 

	OC.NAME, 

	OC.DIAGNOSIS,

	OC.tzx_type, 

	LEFT(ST.STRING,2000) AS CASE_TYPE,

	V.option_value as CASE_OPEN_REASON,

	V1.option_value as CASE_SOURCE,

	OC.CREATE_DATE ,

	OC.CLOSE_DATE ,

	OCS.STATUS,

	OC.CONSENT_DATE ,

	CASE

		WHEN CONSENT_TYPE = 1 AND ISDATE(SUBSTRING(OC.CONSENT_REASON, 1, 10)) = 1 THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(OC.CONSENT_REASON, 1, 10) AS DATETIME)

		ELSE NULL

	END AS CARE_PLAN_CMP_DT

	FROM

	CKOLTP.MEMBER M

	INNER JOIN CKOLTP.ORG_PATIENT P WITH (NOLOCK) ON M.CID = P.CID

	--Removed join through to the ARE, now using the new xwalk table.

	INNER JOIN APP_RPTS.CID_MEMBER_SUBSCRIBER_XWALK X WITH (NOLOCK) ON P.CID = X.CID

	INNER JOIN APP_RPTS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG ELIG WITH (NOLOCK) ON X.MEME_CK = ELIG.MEME_CK

	INNER JOIN APP_RPTS.CMC_CSPI_CS_PLAN PLANAPP WITH (NOLOCK) ON ELIG.CSCS_ID = PLANAPP.CSCS_ID

		AND ELIG.CSPI_ID = PLANAPP.CSPI_ID

		AND ELIG.GRGR_CK  = PLANAPP.GRGR_CK

	INNER JOIN APP_RPTS.CMC_SGSG_SUB_GROUP SGSG WITH (NOLOCK) ON ELIG.SGSG_CK = SGSG.SGSG_CK

	INNER JOIN APP_RPTS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR WITH (NOLOCK) ON SGSG.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK

	INNER JOIN CKOLTP.ORG_CASE OC WITH (NOLOCK) ON P.ID = OC.PATIENT_ID

	INNER JOIN CKOLTP.ORG_CASE_STATUS OCS WITH (NOLOCK) ON OC.STATUS = OCS.ID



	LEFT JOIN (	SELECT ID, TYPE_ID, SUB_ID, LOCALE_ID, MG_ID, STRING 

					FROM CKOLTP.STRING_LOCALE 

					WHERE ID =18   

						AND MG_ID =50 

						AND   INACTIVE =0 

						AND protected=''N''

				) ST ON ST.SUB_ID = OC.tzx_type	-- LIST OF OPTINO AVAILABLE FOR cASE TYPE

	LEFT JOIN APP_RPTS.vw_xml_reference V	on OC.VF_05 =CAST(V.option_id AS VARCHAR) 

											AND V.control_id=''VF_05''

	LEFT JOIN APP_RPTS.vw_xml_reference V1	on OC.VF_04 =CAST(V1.option_id AS VARCHAR) 

											AND V1.control_id=''VF_04''

WHERE

	OC.UM = 0
	AND OC.name !=''General''
	AND OC.CREATE_DATE >=''01/01/2009'' 

	AND OC.CREATE_DATE BETWEEN ELIG.MEPE_EFF_DT AND ELIG.MEPE_TERM_DT  AND GRGR.GRGR_CK IN ("', variables('v_marketList'), ')')
